{{Otheruses|Flare}}
[[File:Stealth_ship_flares.png|thumb|right|250px|A [[Stealth ship/Legends|stealth ship]] launching countermeasure flares]]
A '''flare''' was a pyrotechnic device that either functioned as a [[warhead countermeasure]] on a [[Starship/Legends|starship]], or as a [[Flare gun|signal flare]] to transmit a priority message if communications were not functioning.

[[File:Flare-Hope.jpg|thumb|left|200px|The [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic]] signals their victory in the [[Battle of Alderaan]]]]
Countermeasure flares were anti-[[Warhead/Legends|warhead]] defense mechanisms used by small spacecraft. They consisted of a supply of small, inexpensive low-yield warheads whose targeting systems were designed to home in on incoming warheads and detonate them before they posed a threat to the ship itself. If no incoming warheads were detected, the flare would instead home in on the nearest enemy starfighter, though not powerful enough to cause significant damage, it was useful as brief distraction. While less accurate, and therefore less reliable, than the [[Chaff/Legends|chaff]] type, the flare was more versatile.

Signal flares were used to quickly display a visual signal over a long distance when trying to either maintain communications silence, or if communications were down. These were usually color-coded and sometimes emitted certain sounds to correspond to whatever situation the priority message was pertaining to. For example, during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], when [[Clone Commander/Legends|Commander]] [[Cody/Legends|Cody]] and [[Clone Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Rex/Legends|Rex]] arrived for an inspection, [[Clone trooper/Legends|clone trooper]] [[Fives/Legends|Fives]] shot a red flare that alerted them of [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Separatist]] [[BX-series droid commando/Legends|droid commando's]] presence in [[Rishi Station/Legends|Rishi Station]].
